entries.title: Psalms 130:1
segments:
PSALM CXXX. 
 
  The psalmist confessing his sins, expresses his hope in God, ver. 1-6.   And exhorts Israel to hope in him, ver.7, 8.   A song of degrees.

entries.title: Psalms 130:3
segments: V. 3. Mark-Observe them accurately and punish them as they deserve. Stand-At thy tribunal.

entries.title: Psalms 130:4
segments: V. 4. Forgiveness-Thou art able and ready to forgive repenting sinners. Feared-Not with a slavish, but with a childlike fear.  This mercy of thine is the foundation of all religion, without which men would desperately proceed in their impious courses.

entries.title: Psalms 130:5
segments: V. 5. I wait-That he would pardon my sins.

entries.title: Psalms 130:6
segments: V. 6. They-Whether soldiers that keep the night-watches in an army, or the priests or Levites who did so in the temple.

entries.title: Psalms 130:7
segments: V. 7. Israel-Every true Israelite.  Plenteous-Abundantly sufficient for all persons who accept it upon God's terms.
